interface.name: devos_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description: Desktop identifiers are one-based configuration order. Snapshots are bounded by begin/done. Window identifiers are existing zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 resource IDs in the requesting client's namespace.

request.name: create
request.description: Appends an empty desktop for the current compositor session and activates it.

request.name: remove
request.description: Moves its windows to the preceding desktop, or the next desktop when removing the first. The final desktop cannot be removed. Desktop identifiers are renumbered after removal.

request.name: set_layout
request.description: Select a zero-based group in the compositor keyboard keymap.
